dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is persistent HDF5-backed agent memory, and the documented capabilities, including saving, searching, recalling, exporting, snapshotting, and generating summaries, align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Commands are user-directed examples, but the workflow encourages saving conversation exchanges without much privacy, consent, retention, or redaction guidance.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The setup script only checks for the edgehdf5 command and runs cargo install edgehdf5-cli if missing; this is disclosed, but users must trust the external Cargo package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact uses user-selected HDF5 and WAL files and shows no hidden credential access, unrelated filesystem traversal, undisclosed network endpoint, or automatic exfiltration.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is central and disclosed, but memory files, WAL files, snapshots, exports, and generated AGENTS.md summaries may remain on disk and expose prior conversation content if mishandled.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The persistent conversation-memory concern is valid as user guidance, but durable conversation storage is the explicit purpose rather than hidden or unrelated behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The AGENTS.md generation concern is a real accidental-disclosure risk, but the command is disclosed and user-directed.
[SQP-2] expected: The export command can dump all saved memory entries, but bulk export is documented as part of memory management and does not indicate exfiltration by itself.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to keep local long-term memory. Avoid storing secrets, credentials, regulated data, or private conversations without consent. Protect the .h5, .wal, snapshot, export, and AGENTS.md files, and verify the edgehdf5-cli Cargo package before installing.
llm.summary: This is a clearly disclosed local long-term memory skill, but users should handle saved memory files and exports as sensitive data.
